collection: PHC — Gestural Abstract Skills / Palette v3
palette_rule: Black background, cream body, exactly one attribute hue for all remaining colour and shading.

endurance.name: Endurance
endurance.lighting: bold saturated crimson-red pigment and shading

expression.name: Expression
expression.lighting: deep petrol-blue shading, restricted dark-to-middle values

virtue.name: Virtue
virtue.lighting: dark mulberry shading, restricted dark-to-middle values

portraits.meaning: Physical resilience; a living system continues bearing pressure.
portraits.physique: Short, very stocky, barrel torso, thick forearms and short bowed legs. About five head-heights in stature, unmistakably squat rather than an athletic mannequin.
portraits.pose: Full body, three-quarter view facing LEFT. Hunker down in a WIDE planted defensive crouch, both forearms raised protectively over the bowed head, knees bent outward. Broad back forms an arch on right. Three short attribute-coloured impact marks hit and flatten against that back. Preserve the instantly readable protective pose from the durability reference, but make the body shorter, broader and more fragmented inside. The head is tucked into the elbows as an incomplete irregular impression, no mask. Keep thick substantial elbows and short grounded legs legible. Weight and stubborn endurance.

portraits.meaning: Continuing through pain; sensation is not allowed to stop the body.
portraits.physique: Tall, rangy, sinewy, narrow hips, prominent long elbows and knees expressed as simple bends, not muscles.
portraits.pose: Full body in profile facing RIGHT. A painful LIMP forward: weight carried on one long firmly planted leg, trailing leg dragging, one hand clamps the opposite upper arm tightly, shoulders pulled in and torso slightly hunched. Head is thrown back just a little in an involuntary flinch, while the foot still steps onward. A attribute-coloured jagged pain signal cuts through the held arm, but a single steady attribute-coloured stroke continues down the leading leg. This is continuing while hurt, not sprinting or magical resistance. No blood or wounds, no prop. Hand visibly holds opposite arm.

portraits.meaning: Touch, smell, temperature and bodily vibration; porous awareness of the immediate world.
portraits.physique: Small compact body, soft rounded belly and broad hips, delicate long fingers; low centre of gravity.
portraits.pose: Compact abstract figure kneeling in side view, one large palm pressed to an implied ground plane, other hand at upper chest; attribute-coloured ripples travel from grounded palm toward body.

portraits.meaning: Unrefined muscular force: bend, lift and pull harder.
portraits.physique: Exceptionally massive, top-heavy, broad-backed body, enormous forearms, small tucked head and thick thighs. Clearly the largest build in the set, no defined bodybuilding muscles.
portraits.pose: Full body in a powerful LOW DIAGONAL PULL facing RIGHT. Both hands grip the opposite ends of a single thick attribute-coloured band in front of the waist and WRENCH IT APART. Elbows driven out wide, torso leans back, one short planted leg forward and the other braced behind. The band ruptures in one simple unmistakable split between the hands, with just two broad attribute-coloured pressure strokes. Keep the hands separated and clear, not hands at chest. Heavy thick cream paint masses and black absences. Read: raw force breaking resistance.

portraits.meaning: Courage while afraid; advancing into danger without becoming invulnerable.
portraits.physique: Small wiry body, narrow shoulders, thin shins, disproportionately large feet, vulnerable rather than powerful.
portraits.pose: Full figure occupies roughly the lower TWO THIRDS, leaving a large threatening black space upper right. Step boldly UP AND RIGHT into a massive dark pressure wedge edged with only a few attribute-coloured strokes. One foot already crosses its edge; shoulders recoil in fear, back hand held open behind, forward hand clenched at the side. Head turns toward the threat although torso wants to pull away. Gesture combines FEAR AND COMMITMENT. Do not make the figure so tiny that posture cannot be read. No monster, face, sword or shield.

portraits.meaning: Projecting fear outward and controlling another person through it.
portraits.physique: Very tall, thick neck, unusually long arms, heavy sloping shoulders, narrow lower body. An imposing hunched giant rather than a wide bodybuilder.
portraits.pose: Crop at mid-shin with dramatic LOW-ANGLE foreshortening. Figure LEANS CLOSE toward the viewer, both hands planted wide on an implied low ledge at the bottom corners, elbows locked; hunched shoulders loom over the camera. Tilt the incomplete head down into the shoulders. Large hands frame the bottom; the back is high in frame. Its near-black shadow expands behind into a huge dark shoulder mass outlined in muted GOLD. Only one figure, no ledge rendered, no monster or face. Read: invasive threatening presence filling your space.

portraits.meaning: Freedom and control of whole-body movement; flexible, agile motion.
portraits.physique: Long-legged, light, narrow-shouldered, elongated torso, small compact head impression; a lithe dancer build.
portraits.pose: Full body suspended in a vigorous VAULT diagonally from lower LEFT toward upper RIGHT. One palm pushes against a small simple cream horizontal edge at lower left, one knee tucked high near chest, the other leg extends long behind horizontally, free arm reaches overhead toward upper right. Large open black gap under the lifted hips. One thin attribute-coloured arc follows the back foot through the vault. No arena or background, edge is only a short mark indicating leverage. Clearly vaulting, not running or flying, all limbs readable.

portraits.meaning: Precise hand control and practiced coordination.
portraits.physique: Compact narrow torso, small shoulders, unusually large expressive hands and long fingers. No generic muscular arms.
portraits.pose: WAIST-UP crop, body seated low on right, head bowed over TWO LARGE HANDS held near upper-left centre. One hand steadies a small dark ring edged in attribute-coloured, other passes a fine attribute-coloured thread precisely through it. Offset wrists and carefully separated grouped fingertips make the exact placement immediately readable. Tiny working gap is focal but hands occupy enough frame to see at thumbnail size. The elbows form a quiet asymmetric triangular support. Only one ring and one thread; no multiple intricate mechanisms, guns or tools. Precision and concentration.

portraits.meaning: Responding before conscious deliberation catches up.
portraits.physique: Very lean, long forearms, narrow waist, broad low hips and springlike long legs; change the reference proportions without changing its recognizable dodge.
portraits.pose: Full body, emphatic LOW SIDEWAYS DUCK toward RIGHT. One palm planted lower right, opposite arm flies backward left, near knee tucks under chest, other leg extends long back left. Head and shoulders dip clearly below one horizontal attribute-coloured strike sweeping overhead. A subordinate dark attribute-coloured broken head-and-shoulder afterimage stays higher behind at left. Keep reference action but give limbs a more whip-like elongated proportion and slightly stronger black cutouts. Pose remains completely readable. No running, no floating strips.

portraits.meaning: Stealth, sleight of hand and unnoticed intervention.
portraits.physique: Short narrow body with long flexible arms, small torso and knees folded close; compact and sly.
portraits.pose: Full figure in a THREE-QUARTER BACK VIEW crouches and twists LEFT around a tall narrow black plane occupying the right third, barely edged in sea-teal. One visible hand offers a conspicuous small cream coin-shape leftward; the OTHER hand slips around behind the back to quietly lift a second sea-teal small token from the plane edge. Show two distinct hand actions, a tucked low head angled toward the visible decoy, crouched legs. The figure largely hides in black, but hands/shoulder/knees establish the gesture. Stealth and sleight of hand, not a standing pointing magician.

portraits.meaning: Understanding, repairing and manipulating mechanisms.
portraits.physique: Broad soft middle, short thick upper arms, wide hands, rounded back and squat legs; an unglamorous sturdy build.
portraits.pose: SIDE VIEW facing RIGHT, seated on one heel with the other knee raised. Forearms rest across that raised knee; hands carefully BRING TWO BROKEN JOINT HALVES TOGETHER at middle-right. One half has a clear stepped tab, the other a matching slot; a sea-teal seam shows the correct fit. Head bends low and close to the work, elbows asymmetrical. Repaired joint is big enough to read without becoming a complex machine. No tools, clothes or workshop. Quiet competent making and fixing.

portraits.meaning: Watchfulness for sight, sound and approaching hostile intent.
portraits.physique: Extremely tall and slender, long neck, narrow shoulders, high hips and long straight lower legs.
portraits.pose: Three-quarter-length figure at RIGHT abruptly TWISTS BACK toward upper LEFT as if hearing something behind it. One hand cups beside the incomplete head, the other arm stretches outward across the frame with a clear STOP palm. Lower torso still points right. A single small sea-teal disturbance at far left sends two very sparse sound curves toward the cupped hand. Long vertical stance, sudden upper-body turn, frozen attention. No visible ears, eyes, facial features or antennae. This must read as alert listening and stopping.

portraits.meaning: Fast processing, exact thought and the mental force that drives Sigils.
portraits.physique: Slim angular body, oversized incomplete cranium impression, long fine forearms, narrow chest. Cerebral proportions without caricature face.
portraits.pose: CHEST-UP frontal composition, head bowed slightly forward, both hands raised to either side of the incomplete head, fingertips near the temples but not covering the silhouette. Elbows point down at different heights. Three icy-cyan angular thought paths enter wide, converge in the black head-space and emerge as ONE precise small geometric command form just above it. Keep head outline, hands and shoulders strongly readable. No exposed brain, crown, text or floating tower. Body and face incomplete print marks, not a cybernetic helmet. Concentrated mental effort processing complexity.

portraits.meaning: Scientific knowledge, remembered facts and retrieving relevant understanding.
portraits.physique: Older-feeling rounded stoop, soft narrow shoulders, thick seated waist and long slightly bony hands, no facial aging details.
portraits.pose: THREE-QUARTER seated thinker, entire body shown compactly with one knee raised high, elbow resting on that knee, hand supporting the lowered chin-position (no actual chin or face features). Other arm reaches down into a small fan of cream memory-leaf impressions beside the hip. A single icy-cyan thread traces from the retrieved leaf toward the bowed head. Pensive inward weight; curved back and supported-head gesture instantly read as remembering. No literal book text, spirals, shell body or shelves.

portraits.meaning: Logic and argument; making a conclusion difficult to escape.
portraits.physique: Tall lean chest, long arms, narrow waist, erect neck; spare authoritative debater build.
portraits.pose: Waist-up explaining gesture: one index finger raised beside the head, other open palm extended to the listener; three orderly cyan argument marks above the palm.

portraits.meaning: Imagining an unseen form and giving it coherent shape.
portraits.physique: Long torso, narrow ribcage, broad hips, long elegant arms and wrists; elongated rather than muscular.
portraits.pose: KNEES-UP figure leans BACK and looks up at a shape it is framing. One hand high at upper left and other hand low at centre-right create two OPPOSING L-SHAPED framing gestures, like an artist composing an image. Between those hands, a simple blue-teal outlined impossible arch becomes partly solid cream on one side. Keep actual forearms and shoulders in natural readable relation, body slightly off-centre left. The created arch is smaller than the figure, not a replacement for the torso. Wonder and shaping imagination.

portraits.meaning: Dissecting evidence and discovering the structure or weak point beneath appearances.
portraits.physique: Small fine-boned body, sloping shoulders, compact chest, large precise hands; almost delicate.
portraits.pose: WAIST-UP figure bent sharply FORWARD, head close to the evidence at lower right. One hand spreads a single broad cracked cream plane open while the other pinches and LIFTS ONE tiny blue-teal misplaced fragment out of the crack. The plane is a simple metaphorical evidence surface, not a floating architectural body. One elbow held high left, opposite elbow low; strong diagonal gaze-direction through featureless head tilt. Read: inspecting closely, isolating the crucial flaw. No lens prop, text or brain.

portraits.meaning: Warmth, persuasion and inviting others into the rhythm of your speech.
portraits.physique: Full-figured body with soft belly, broad hips, rounded shoulders, expressive broad hands; confident and buoyant, not slim mannequin.
portraits.pose: THIGH-UP three-quarter view facing RIGHT, relaxed hip shift and open chest. One large hand extends toward the viewer PALM UP in a warm beckoning invitation, the other arm sweeps broadly outward to the side. Head tipped companionably toward the open hand, posture relaxed and welcoming. A few blue-teal loose marks gather inward to the offered palm. No heart emblem, mouth, literal audience, dramatic spell or finger-pointing. Generous open asymmetrical silhouette, inviting rather than commanding.

portraits.meaning: Receiving and understanding another person’s emotional experience.
portraits.physique: Soft, broad and rounded body, gentle sloping shoulders, full upper arms and substantial hands; warmer and less athletic than the approved test.
portraits.pose: WAIST-UP three-quarter pose toward LEFT, lean forward tenderly with bowed incomplete head and relaxed shoulders. Both hands CUP together at lower left to receive a small trembling rose wave. Wave continues as one rose band along the forearms. Keep the approved receiving pose, but give figure a fuller, softer silhouette and slightly larger deliberate black absences through neck and far chest. Face is an incomplete dark head-space, no smooth mask. No orb, heart icon or magical explosion. Attention and caring.

portraits.meaning: Mutual support, belonging and acting as part of a trusted group.
portraits.physique: Short square torso, thick sturdy legs, long strong forearms and broad palm; grounded supportive build.
portraits.pose: Full figure in a deep LUNGE facing LEFT, rear knee down, front foot planted firmly. One arm reaches diagonally up-left and CLASPS a second isolated forearm entering from outside the frame; its other hand braces under the joined wrists, visibly helping pull someone up. The outside forearm is an anonymous echo of the same self, not another NPC. Strong clear handclasp and two bodies sharing weight implied by their opposed pulls. A single rose band binds the shared grip. No crowd or woven bridge. Read instantly as helping a comrade to their feet.

portraits.meaning: Subtext, metaphor and the meaning hidden beneath an obvious statement.
portraits.physique: Slender softly curved body, long neck, narrow shoulders, very long expressive wrists; tilted playful elegance.
portraits.pose: Shoulder-and-arms close-up with tilted head: one open palm offered left, opposite arm bent behind shoulder points right; its rose shadow reveals the concealed meaning.

portraits.meaning: Soul strength, sustained connection and self-command under inner pressure.
portraits.physique: Exceptionally thin tall body, long trunk and thin limbs, narrow but resilient shoulders, almost fragile-looking.
portraits.pose: Full figure UPRIGHT in a narrow staggered stance, one foot braced forward, head bowed slightly. Both arms grip TWO violet bands pulling away to left and right; elbows drawn tightly toward waist as the figure RESISTS being pulled apart. One thin continuous cream line through its broken torso remains upright. Whole action like holding opposing forces steady, hands at waist not chest. Violet tension sits at grips and outer bands; no central explosion. Long vulnerable body holds together through intention rather than bulk.

portraits.meaning: Knowledge of the occult, old stories and the hidden agency behind impossible events.
portraits.physique: Bent, compact, wide upper back, thin long reaching forearms and unusually large open hands; ancient-feeling stoop without a literal elderly face.
portraits.pose: THREE-QUARTER rear view, figure KNEELS and reaches one arm HIGH above its shoulder, tracing a single large archaic violet curve suspended in the black. Other hand holds a small OPEN CREAM LEAF/BOOK-like impression low beside the knee, connecting remembered lore below to hidden meaning above. Head tilted upward toward the tracing fingertips, back hunched, shoulder blades only broad paint masses. One partially erased older curve sits behind the new trace. No readable text, ritual circle, scholar clothes or crown. Read: recognizing an old hidden story and tracing its significance.

portraits.meaning: Containing outward emotion and staying steady under pressure.
portraits.physique: Broad, heavy, rounded seated body with very low shoulders, thick upper arms and short limbs; rooted comfortable mass.
portraits.pose: Full figure sits CROSS-LEGGED low in frame, facing nearly front but slightly right. Shoulders absolutely level, head bowed a little; both hands rest OPEN and still on the knees, not praying. Torso contains one simple level cream interval. Three harsh violet brush gusts sweep horizontally around and above it, never shifting the body. Keep generous black space upper third, calm seat occupies lower two thirds. No meditation costume, halo, lotus symbol or serene face. Unmoved outward composure, grounded rather than hovering.

portraits.meaning: Trust offered beyond oneself and a prayer that may be answered.
portraits.physique: Tall long-waisted body with narrow shoulders, very long upper arms, broad knees and delicate hands; openly vulnerable proportions.
portraits.pose: Full body in SIDE VIEW facing RIGHT, KNEELING on both knees with back arched upward and head tilted up. Two open hands stretch high but stay separated, receiving rather than commanding. A small descending magenta-and-cream stroke meets one rising magenta gesture just above the fingertips. Keep a clear human torso, bent knees and upward offering; no giant abstract chalice, halo, church, cross or face. Read as hopeful prayer answered from beyond, not conjuring.

portraits.meaning: Recognizing consequences and choosing an action with moral awareness.
portraits.physique: Medium-height compact body with a strong rounded waist, broad thighs and narrow sloping shoulders; neither fragile nor imposing.
portraits.pose: THIGH-UP three-quarter view, hips advance RIGHT while shoulders twist urgently back LEFT. One arm has reached out to right with open hand, but the OTHER HAND firmly CATCHES ITS OWN WRIST, arresting the action. Oversize the clasp just enough that self-restraint reads instantly. Head inclined toward the caught wrist, incomplete face. One magenta motion trail stops abruptly at that grip; behind it a faint dark consequence mark falls away. No separate restraining person, scales or morality symbols. Read: choosing to stop yourself.

portraits.meaning: Calm command, recognized presence and directing others under pressure.
portraits.physique: Tall broad-hipped body, straight back, substantial shoulders and long forearms; a balanced commanding silhouette, not intimidating bulk.
portraits.pose: KNEES-UP three-quarter view facing LEFT, weight settled on one straight leg, other knee relaxed. One arm extends HORIZONTALLY with a firm palm DOWN, calmly signalling hold position; other hand points low in a second precise direction. Head erect above squared shoulders, entirely faceless. Below the level palm, three scattered magenta strokes settle into three short parallel aligned rows. A confident calm officer-like gesture without uniform, weapon or crown. Read: clear direction that others can follow, never threatening looming or a theatrical spell.
